newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA GROUP PROFIT UP IN MAY.
newsitem.headline: HANSA GROUP PROFIT UP IN MAY.

text.p: Estonia's leading commercial bank, Hansapank, said on Wednesday that its consolidated May profit was 43.1 million kroons compared to 35.3 million kroons in April.
The group's deposits grew by 122.3 million kroons or 2.4 percent during the month, totalling 5.2 billion kroons, it added in a statement.
Time deposits increased by 21.1 percent in May to 1.5 billion kroons and demand deposits decreased by 4.5 percent to 3.7 billion kroons during the month.
From the beginning of the year, total deposits have increased by 20.5 percent.
Total shareholders' equity rose by 5.1 percent during the month to 964.7 billion kroons.
The loan portfolio rose by eight percent to 4.7 billion kroons. The allowances for credit losses amounted to 75.1 million kroons or 1.6 percent of the total loan portfolio.
Hansapank group total assets decreased by 0.4 percent to 9.18 billion kroons. The group had a market share of 12 percent in the Baltic countries.
